title: Slowing down in the AI race would benefit US adversaries, Super Intelligence Force vice chair says
key_facts: Scott Kupor is vice chair of the Super Intelligence Force.
He appeared on the Fox News programme 'Saturday in America'.
He discussed the balance between protecting the American people and keeping the US technological edge in the AI race.
He argued that slowing down could benefit America's adversaries.
quote_evidence: He discusses the importance of continuing to advance artificial intelligence and argues that slowing down could benefit America’s adversaries on ‘Saturday in America.’
why_it_matters_hint: A government AI official argues against slowing down while senators call for a pause.
